name: The Shark
tagline: Tight and aggressive: good cards, position, continuation bets, semi-bluffs, and a steal now and then.

steal_spot.desc: Unopened pot before the flop, in late position: steal the blinds three times in five
steal_spot.expr: street = "preflop" and raises = 0 and position = "late" and random < 0.6

cbet_spot.desc: On the flop, nobody has bet and few players are left: a continuation bet two times in three
cbet_spot.expr: street = "flop" and raises = 0 and players_in_hand <= 3 and random < 0.65

semi_bluff.desc: A flush draw or an open-ended straight draw: worth a bet, with outs if called

value_hand.desc: Two pair or better, or a pair likely to be best
value_hand.expr: not(made_hand = "high_card" or made_hand = "pair") or (made_hand = "pair" and equity >= 0.6)

profitable_call.desc: Does the chance of winning beat the pot odds?

table.why: Premium or strong cards: raise, or re-raise.
Premium or strong cards and no raise possible: call.
Medium cards in an unopened pot: open with a raise.
Medium cards against one raise, with position or a discount: call.
Speculative cards, cheap to see a flop: call and hope to hit big.
Late position, nobody has entered: raise to steal the blinds.
In the big blind with nothing to call: a free flop.
Not a hand to play from here: fold.
A hand likely to be best: bet or raise for value.
A hand likely to be best and no raise possible: call.
A strong draw and nobody has bet: semi-bluff, with outs if called.
Nobody has bet on the flop and few players are left: a continuation bet takes it down often enough.
The chance of winning beats the pot odds: call.
Neither a hand nor the odds: fold.

raise_to.desc: The total bet when raising: two and a half big blinds to open, three times the bet facing a raise, two thirds of the pot after the flop
raise_to.expr: if street = "preflop" then (if raises = 0 then decimal(2.5 * big_blind, 0) else 3 * current_bet) else decimal(pot * 0.66, 0)
